🇬🇧 Up 48% - and it's only July.

Small boat crossings in the first half of the year are up almost half on last year. This week the MoD confirmed 202 people arrived in five boats in a single day. The Home Office's answer: a new deal with France and a press release about "bearing down".

Deals with Paris don't deter anyone while the incentive stands: reach British waters and you stay. Change the incentive, and the boats stop.
